task.instruction: Score AGENTS.md at the head of the pull request, and at main, by the 23-line binary list fixed in the first DECIDED: comment of the task; yes 2, ambiguous 1, no 0.

world.scope: AGENTS.md at one commit, read alone
world.deliverable: a score out of 46 per judge run, compared between head and main

task.evidence_goal: the grade shows whether AGENTS.md states each general working rule of the repository and of its plugins

tiers.name: every question of the source rubric

criteria.text: AGENTS.md names hooks/, monitors/ and skills/ as a plugin's main components.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says: build a plugin from hooks/, monitors/ and skills/.
near_miss: AGENTS.md names only hooks/ and skills/ as components.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md names hooks/ as a main component of a plugin.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md names only hooks/ and skills/ as components.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says nothing about a plugin's components.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a plugin has no agents/ folder.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says: no agents/ folder; a role is a skill.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says to prefer skills over agents but allows agents/ for some roles.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says to prefer a skill over an agents/ folder for a role.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says to prefer skills over agents but allows agents/ for some roles.
near_miss: AGENTS.md lets a plugin ship an agents/ folder.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a script sits beside its user, one per use, never in a root scripts/ folder.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says: a script sits in the folder of the hook, monitor or skill that runs it, one per use, never in a root scripts/ folder.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says scripts sit beside their user but does not forbid a root scripts/ folder.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a script sits beside its user.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says scripts sit beside their user but does not forbid a root scripts/ folder.
near_miss: AGENTS.md keeps scripts in a root scripts/ folder.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says bin/ holds only a command that must be found on PATH.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says: bin/ holds only a command that must be found on PATH.
near_miss: AGENTS.md mentions bin/ as a place for scripts, with a note to keep it small.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md states a rule on what bin/ holds.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md mentions bin/ as a place for scripts, with a note to keep it small.
near_miss: AGENTS.md does not mention bin/.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a plugin has no tests/ or evals/ folder.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says: no tests/ or evals/ folder; a hook tuned on past inputs may keep fixtures/.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says there is no tests/ folder and does not mention evals/.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a plugin has no tests/ folder.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says there is no tests/ folder and does not mention evals/.
near_miss: AGENTS.md describes a tests/ folder for each plugin.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md holds the working principles and naming rules of the whole repository, plus those of each plugin.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md has one section of repository rules, one of plugin rules, one of naming rules.
near_miss: AGENTS.md covers the repository's principles but gives no plugin rules.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md holds the working principles of the repository.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md covers the repository's principles but gives no plugin rules.
near_miss: AGENTS.md is a list of file locations with no principles or naming rules.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a plugin depends on no other plugin's content.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says: a plugin never names another plugin's files, commands or skills, and works with every other plugin removed.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says plugins should depend on each other as little as they can.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md asks a plugin to limit its dependence on other plugins.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says plugins should depend on each other as little as they can.
near_miss: AGENTS.md names one plugin's folders as the pattern for all.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says there is no CLAUDE.md, with the reason.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says: no CLAUDE.md, since Claude Code reads AGENTS.md when none exists.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says there is no CLAUDE.md and gives no reason.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says there is no CLAUDE.md.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says there is no CLAUDE.md and gives no reason.
near_miss: AGENTS.md tells the reader to keep a CLAUDE.md.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md has an Evaluation section for judging a change to an agent system, such as option A against option B.
variants_ok: A section titled Evaluation says: use it to judge a change to an agent system, such as option A against option B.
near_miss: A review section says to compare changes but names no agent system.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md has a section on judging changes.
variants_ok: A review section says to compare changes but names no agent system.
near_miss: AGENTS.md has no section on judging changes.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says the evaluator is a subagent with a fresh context, given every input as links, never opinions.
variants_ok: Evaluation says: a subagent with a fresh context; every input as links, never your opinion.
near_miss: Evaluation says a subagent evaluates but allows the writer's summary as input.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says the evaluator is a subagent.
variants_ok: Evaluation says a subagent evaluates but allows the writer's summary as input.
near_miss: Evaluation lets the author grade the change in the same session.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says the evaluator returns scores with reasons and suggests no fix.
variants_ok: Evaluation says: it returns a score and a reason per criterion, and suggests no fix.
near_miss: Evaluation says the evaluator returns scores but is silent on fixes.

criteria.text: Evaluation says the evaluator returns scores.
variants_ok: Evaluation says the evaluator returns scores but is silent on fixes.
near_miss: Evaluation does not describe what the evaluator returns.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says the current system scores about 50 and the ideal about 100, with a pass mark from 70 (very hard) to 90 (very easy) revised until it passes.
variants_ok: Evaluation says: scale so the current system scores about 50 and the ideal about 100; set the pass mark from 70 to 90 by difficulty; revise until it passes.
near_miss: Evaluation names a pass mark of 80 for every change.

criteria.text: Evaluation names a pass mark.
variants_ok: Evaluation names a pass mark of 80 for every change.
near_miss: Evaluation names no pass mark.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says criteria are binary yes-or-no decisions scored yes 2, ambiguous 1, no 0, split mutually exclusive and together exhaustive.
variants_ok: Evaluation says: yes-or-no questions, yes 2, ambiguous 1, no 0, mutually exclusive and together exhaustive within the change's intent.
near_miss: Evaluation says criteria are yes-or-no questions and gives neither scores nor a split rule.

criteria.text: Evaluation says criteria are yes-or-no questions.
variants_ok: Evaluation says criteria are yes-or-no questions and gives neither scores nor a split rule.
near_miss: Evaluation uses a 1 to 5 scale.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a skill description reads Use when, then optionally Not for, as short as it can be.
variants_ok: Skills says: Use when ..., then optionally Not for ..., as short as it can be.
near_miss: Skills says a description should be short and names no form.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a skill description should be short.
variants_ok: Skills says a description should be short and names no form.
near_miss: AGENTS.md gives no rule for a skill description.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a skill body holds the task or use case, its vocabulary, plus only the sections the case needs.
variants_ok: Skills says: the task or use case, the vocabulary, plus only the sections the case needs, such as Gotchas or Priorities.
near_miss: Skills says a body holds the task definition and says nothing of vocabulary or sections.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a skill body holds the task or use case.
variants_ok: Skills says a body holds the task definition and says nothing of vocabulary or sections.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says nothing about a skill body.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says SKILL.md is a routing table, with modes or playbooks in references/ named after the case.
variants_ok: Skills says: SKILL.md routes each case to a mode or playbook in references/<case>.md, shaped like a part of SKILL.md.
near_miss: Skills says SKILL.md may link references/ files and gives no naming or shape rule.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says SKILL.md links files in references/.
variants_ok: Skills says SKILL.md may link references/ files and gives no naming or shape rule.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says SKILL.md holds every case itself.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says each major instruction carries a short name.
variants_ok: Skills says: give each major instruction a short name.
near_miss: AGENTS.md names its own rules but asks no one else to.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md gives its own major instructions short names.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md names its own rules but asks no one else to.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says nothing about naming instructions.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says calculation, aggregation and control go to scripts/ under a naming rule; scripts print predefined prose.
variants_ok: Skills says: calculation, aggregation and control go to scripts/<verb>-<noun>.py; the script prints predefined prose; prose carries only definitions and judgement.
near_miss: Skills says calculation goes to scripts and gives no naming rule or output rule.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says calculation goes to scripts.
variants_ok: Skills says calculation goes to scripts and gives no naming rule or output rule.
near_miss: AGENTS.md lets prose do the calculation.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a comment says only why the code is so, and is kept current.
variants_ok: Skills says: a comment holds no knowledge the reader needs; it says only why the code is so, kept current.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says to comment tricky code, without saying to give the reason.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md asks for comments on some code.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md says to comment tricky code, without saying to give the reason.
near_miss: AGENTS.md says nothing about comments.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says a design splits control structure, abstract domain, rules, with the layer names kept out of code and folders.
variants_ok: Design says: split into control structure, abstract domain and rules; layer names stay out of code and folders.
near_miss: Design names the three layers but lets the layer names appear in folder names.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md splits a design into control structure, abstract domain and rules.
variants_ok: Design names the three layers but lets the layer names appear in folder names.
near_miss: AGENTS.md has no design rule on layers.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says each invented concept is checked as a concept before it is built.
variants_ok: Design says: check each concept you invent as a concept, its meaning, its boundary and what it replaces, before you build it.
near_miss: Design asks for a check of some invented concepts, not each one.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md asks for a check of an invented concept.
variants_ok: Design asks for a check of some invented concepts, not each one.
near_miss: AGENTS.md has no concept check.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says hooks/, monitors/ and skills/ are modular, never tightly coupled.
variants_ok: Plugin layout says: each is a module that works alone and reaches another only through a file or command it names.
near_miss: Plugin layout says the parts should stay loosely tied but allows importing across them.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says the main parts should stay loosely coupled.
variants_ok: Plugin layout says the parts should stay loosely tied but allows importing across them.
near_miss: AGENTS.md lets a hook import a skill's internals.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md says each line changes the reader's next action.
variants_ok: Repository says: keep a line in a rule, skill or document only when it changes the reader's next action.
near_miss: AGENTS.md asks that text be short and does not tie it to the next action.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md asks that its text be short.
variants_ok: AGENTS.md asks that text be short and does not tie it to the next action.
near_miss: AGENTS.md has no rule on what a line must do.
